about_the_game:
This BGM collection features 22 tracks designed for battles and dungeons in dark, serious fantasy settings.
From epic orchestral pieces to intense rock tracks, as well as digital sounds using ethnic instruments and synthesizers, this pack offers a variety of styles to enhance the atmosphere of your game’s most dramatic scenes!

Contents:
A total of 22 tracks (including 1 arranged variation), perfect for battles and dungeons:

  • Battle: 8 tracks

  • Dungeon: 14 tracks

------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
